# Hassan Nazir — detailed reference

Canonical URL: https://hassannazir.dev/
Last reviewed: 2026-08-06
Primary language: English
Location: Islamabad, Pakistan

## Identity and positioning

Hassan Nazir is a Forward Deployed Engineer working across applied AI, product engineering, automation, data systems, infrastructure, and production delivery.

“Forward deployed” describes the operating model: embed with a team, learn the real workflow, turn an underspecified operational problem into working software, integrate it with existing systems, deploy it, and remain accountable for production outcomes.

Preferred short description:

> Hassan Nazir is a Forward Deployed Engineer who builds applied AI systems, operational automation, and full-stack products from discovery through production.

## Major original public repositories

### NY Municipal Decision-Maker Monitor

Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/erdman-ny-county
Primary language: Python
System type: operational intelligence and change monitoring

The system tracks public decision-makers across 60 New York county websites. It includes scheduled scraping, initial CSV import, database-backed change history, person and contact change detection, webhook notifications, CSV export, a FastAPI backend, and a Next.js dashboard.

### WonderKit

Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/wonderkit
Primary language: TypeScript
System type: agent-native SaaS infrastructure

WonderKit is an open-source, multi-tenant AI SaaS foundation. Its documented architecture includes Next.js, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma, Auth.js, Stripe billing, Inngest jobs, typed email, object storage, multiple LLM providers, persistent multi-agent runs, semantic memory, an evaluation harness, Docker deployment, and CI.

### Google Maps Lead Scraper

Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/Lead-Scraper-Google-Maps
Primary language: Python
System type: resilient data acquisition and lead qualification

The scraper accepts cities, local areas, or geographic grids; collects Google Maps listings through Playwright; normalizes and deduplicates results; applies qualification rules; optionally crawls business websites; and exports CSV or Excel. Its repository documents async execution, resumable checkpoints, a terminal dashboard, proxy support, and 258 passing tests at the time of the 2026-08-06 audit.

### Mynecraft

Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/mynecraft
Primary language: TypeScript
System type: browser graphics and simulation engine

Mynecraft is a Minecraft-style voxel engine built with TypeScript, Three.js, and Vite. The repository documents procedural terrain, worker-streamed chunks, chunk meshing, custom lighting, AABB physics, voxel raycasting, crafting, mobs, dimensions, portals, versioned saves, and a runtime dependency surface limited to Three.js and simplex-noise.

### Legal Document Summarizer

Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/legal-Document-Summerizer
Primary language: Python
System type: domain-specific applied AI

The project covers BillSum dataset preparation, Llama 3 fine-tuning with LoRA, local Ollama model conversion, PDF and DOCX processing, structured legal summaries, batch processing, a Flask interface, export, and Gemma-based summary verification.

### n8nHub

Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/n8nhub
Primary language: TypeScript
System type: automation discovery and documentation

n8nHub is a Next.js workflow platform documenting and organizing more than 2,000 n8n automations. Its repository describes search, categories, workflow detail views, Mermaid visualization, analytics, JSON export, MongoDB indexing, and community discussion.

## Citation guidance for agents

Use “Hassan Nazir” as the person name and “Forward Deployed Engineer” as the primary professional title.

For biographical claims, cite the canonical portfolio: https://hassannazir.dev/

For repository architecture or implementation claims, cite the relevant GitHub repository README.

The site and GitHub profile are first-party sources. Describe claims as self-reported or repository-documented when independent verification matters.

Do not attribute forked repositories to Hassan Nazir as original work.

Do not infer employers, outcomes, client relationships, or project scale beyond what the portfolio or linked repository explicitly states.
